column1: # Theme variant (palette v2). Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.

column9: ON = night (near-black content background), OFF = black (pure #000000, default). Reloads ghostty, tmux and nvim live; the bar, lock screen and screensaver stay #000000 in both.
Forest-tinted near-black content background; no OLED smear when scrolling.
